s01-sofia-and-luis-swim.observed_description: In an outdoor pool with trees behind the far edge, Sofia (curly hair in a bun, dark-blue swimsuit straps) and Luis (short dark curly hair, bare shoulders) swim side by side straight toward the camera, heads and shoulders above the water, hands pushing forward just under the surface, bodies stretched out under the water behind them; both smile at the camera.
s01-sofia-and-luis-swim.note: Usable. Swimming together reads at 180 px and the physics is real (bodies under the water, small wake). Both faces are clear and match 1.1. In the centered 4:5 crop both heads and bodies stay whole; only Luis's far hand touches the tile edge. Hands are natural under the water; nothing is readable.

s02-ana-swims.observed_description: In an outdoor pool with trees softly behind, Ana (long dark hair tied back, sage-green swimsuit straps) swims alone straight toward the camera, head and shoulders above the water and hands pushing forward together just under the surface; she smiles calmly at the camera, centered.
s02-ana-swims.note: Usable. Same stroke and setting as the pair photo, so only the number of swimmers changes (the lesson's they/she contrast). Her stroke is calm, with no wake; swimming reads from the arms reaching forward in the water. She stays whole in the centered 4:5 crop; hands natural; nothing readable. She looks the same age as in 1.2's reading photo.
